title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates wavelength using λ = vT with given wave speed and period from graph.

title: Wave propagation time
description: Important: Calculates time for wave to travel from P to Q using t = Δx/v with correct distance.

title: SHM phase timing
description: Important: Determines time for Q to reach first positive maximum from its starting phase (T/4).

title: Total time sum
description: Essential: Correctly adds propagation time and SHM phase time to get final answer 0.55s.

title: Period extraction
description: Important: Correctly reads period T = 0.2s from the vibration graph of point P.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds) throughout calculations.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses negative time or incorrect sign for propagation direction.

title: Phase confusion
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets starting phase of Q or uses wrong fraction of period (e.g., 3T/4 instead of T/4).
